title: Transitivity of promise reductions
statement: Let $A$, $B$, and $C$ be binary promise problems. If $A$ reduces to $B$ and $B$ reduces to $C$ by polynomial-time maps preserving promised yes-instances and no-instances, then $A$ reduces to $C$ by such a map.
hypotheses_covered: A polynomial-time promise-preserving reduction from $A$ to $B$
A polynomial-time promise-preserving reduction from $B$ to $C$
